rules.rule: Name the format first (agent/FORMATS.md: the team's 8 formats and sub-formats) on line 1 of script_analysis.md; each format has its own layouts, zoom and transition pattern.

Split screens never zoom: split_h, split_v and baked splits are always z=1 (no push-in, punch-in, step zoom or pull-out); each panel holds one fixed frame. Emphasis in a split comes from the cut, the words, the marks and clean beat SFX (pop.wav at -3 dB on a key word).

Transitions follow the story, never a clock (W45 editor feedback): one at a new place or time, into or out of a split, or into a separate call-to-action shot; hard cuts everywhere else, never between two cuts of the same shot, inside one line or inside a split. Kind by purpose: whip_left/whip_right/slide_up for a new place, split_reveal@0.40 for a split, dip_to_black for a time jump, dissolve for a flashback; warm_flash/dip_to_white/flash_zoom only when the script asks, once at most. Per-format patterns: agent/FORMATS.md.
Captions: #subs auto y=68 by default, one style, one fixed size, a single row; in a top/bottom split they sit on the divider (y=50) so no face is covered. #subs off ONLY if the user explicitly asks.

Cut >0.25s pauses in full-frame monologues (L4a/L4b masked w/ z=1.08 punch-in); in a split cut only pauses >=0.5s (no zoom hides the cut). Keep dialogue joins 0.06-0.15s, breath pad 0.02-0.05s max (never double-pad facts.md), and wrong/right mark tails 0.35-0.42s (0.48s 2-pulse flash).

Check ! REPEAT / STUMBLE in facts.md: trim every false start, stutter & cross-cut repeat inside cuts and across adjacent cut joins (split mid-sentence stumbles into L5a+L5b masked with z=1.08 punch-in).

Keep # SFX: gains in -4 to 0 dB (pop.wav -3, whoosh.wav/sn_swish_1.wav -3 to -2, sn_riser_1.wav -3 to -2, sn_punch_1.wav -2 to -1; <= 0 dB) since SFX are peak-normalized to -1 dBFS post-loudnorm; # MARKS: defaults are +1.0 dB wrong and +0.5 dB right.
Single-character live hook (layout=single) MUST give top priority to a rapid zoom-in (sudden_in:1.08) on the opening hook beat before any zoom-out.

In full-frame live shots only (single, safe two-shots <=1.10), trigger sudden_in:1.08@<word_t> on Supernova callouts or [STRESS] emphasis words, releasing with sudden_out:1.08 or smooth 1.0->1.06. Never in a split.

In split_h (Left/Right) and split_v (Top/Bottom), both characters share matched headroom (14%) and face scale, and a character's speaking and silent clips are held in the same fixed frame (z=1), so switching between them never jumps.
Respect [FACE_READY] and speech spans in facts.md to trim pre-speech stares and end-of-take freezes: use at most 0.02-0.05 s breath margin around already-padded word timestamps.

For top_pip scenes (Subtopic 1.1 / 3.1), render a clean top-center rounded rectangle window (750x420 at x=165, y=20, radius=36px on 1080x1920, no phone status bar chrome) showing the AI Robot (R1..r4 or looping R extra.mp4 when listening) over the full-screen human background (M1, M2 or looping M extra.mp4 when listening).

When single-character clips (e.g. R1.mp4, M1.mp4, M2.mp4) contain multiple alternating dialogue turns separated by silent listening gaps, split them at tight 0.06-0.15s turn joins to interleave with the partner's turns, and trim every head, mid, or boundary stumble.

When a folder contains both <stem>.mp4 (listening actor video) and <stem>VO.mp4 (phone-partner voiceover audio), mux <stem>.mp4 video (0:v:0) with <stem>VO.mp4 audio (1:a:0) and transfer <stem>VO's word timestamps so the phone reaction shot plays with clean voiceover audio.

Lock zoom=1.0 on every split, on 3D hologram shots, on deliberate camera pans/dollies, and on shared single-camera two-shots whose faces sit near frame edges ('none' in facts.md); safe live two-shots zoom up to 1.10 (focus=x,y).

When an 8s-10s AI clip contains the tail of Speaker A's line + Speaker B's short question + the head of Speaker A's next line, _match_sequence must match all covered lines without early continue, and apply_speaker_check must never amputate legitimate second-speaker turns.

Treat clips with stationary ambient noise (rms_p90 - rms_p50 <= 4.2 dB and active_frac >= 0.90) as silent beat clips (_is_silent=True, clearing any LLM-echoed words), while never misclassifying 1-2 word spoken script lines (e.g. 'Whatever!') as silent beats.
Keep color_match OFF (false) by default so raw clip colours are never altered, and never apply J/L audio-video offsets unless explicitly requested.
